NGINX Return Status of All Stream Limit_conn Zones

params.name: fields
params.description: Limits which fields of limit_conn zones will be output. If the “<literal>fields</literal>” value is empty, then only zone names will be output.

items.docs: Returns status information for each stream [limit_conn zone](https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_limit_conn_module.html#limit_conn_zone).

params.name: fields

items.docs: Returns status of a particular stream [limit_conn zone](https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_limit_conn_module.html#limit_conn_zone).
